name: Fashion glow-up
about: One photo → a vertical fashion clip: FLUX.2 Klein puts the same person into five looks, each a 4 s scene; joined into a video and, with a song, cut to its beat.

data.text:
Fashion glow-up: one photo → a vertical fashion clip in the spirit of the «at home → night out» transitions.

1. Create the graph in 9:16 and upload a photo into the «Photo» node: facing the camera, the face large, even light.
2. Five FLUX.2 Klein «Pictures» take the photo as their reference and draw the same person at home, on a night street, in a lobby, on a runway and on a cover. Each is the first frame of its own «Scene» (4 s); the photo also goes into the «faces» input so that Ref2VA keeps the face.
3. «Shoot all»: «Join» → «Output» gives a video of about 20 s and a phone copy. Put a song into «Song» and «Beat montage» cuts the same scenes to the beat of its drop into the second «Output»; without a song that branch simply waits.
4. The looks change in the «Pictures» prompts. In the scene prompts don't describe the place or the clothes: the picture gives them.

data.title: At home
data.prompt: The person in the first image: exactly the same face, the same haircut and the same clothes. A new photograph of them: a selfie-style chest-up portrait at home in the evening, warm lamp light, a plain bedroom wall behind them, looking straight into the camera, one hand touching the hair. Phone-camera look, natural skin, vertical framing. No text, no logos.

data.title: Night street
data.prompt: The person in the first image: exactly the same face and the same haircut (its length and colour), now in an oversized black leather jacket over a plain black top. A new photograph of them: a windy city street at night beside a glass office tower, cold city lights and bokeh behind them, hair moved by the wind, chest-up, a calm confident look straight into the camera. Cinematic night photo, vertical framing. No text, no logos.

data.title: Lobby
data.prompt: The person in the first image: exactly the same face and the same haircut (its length and colour), now in a sharp tailored black coat, dark sunglasses in one hand. A new photograph of them: walking through a marble office lobby with tall glass walls, reflections on the polished floor, low camera angle, full length. Editorial fashion photo, vertical framing. No text, no logos.

data.title: Runway
data.prompt: The person in the first image: exactly the same face and the same haircut (its length and colour), now in a monochrome tailored outfit: a structured jacket and wide trousers. A new photograph of them: mid-stride on a fashion-show runway, bright camera flashes and a dark audience behind them, full length, strong editorial look, vertical framing. No text, no logos.

data.title: Cover
data.prompt: The person in the first image: exactly the same face and the same haircut (its length and colour), now in a crisp white shirt with the collar up and bold jewellery. A new photograph of them: a magazine-cover style studio portrait against a plain pale backdrop, hard direct flash, a sharp shadow on the wall, chest-up, the chin slightly lifted, looking into the camera. High-fashion editorial photo, vertical framing. No text, no letters, no logos.
